title: Scissor Clipping
description: Nested scrolling panels intersect parent and child scissor rectangles. Draw state is restored after the clipping pass.
controls: Space pauses scrolling; Up/Down change the shared parameter.
checks: Pixel readbacks check the untouched outer corners and the nested parent region.

title: Stencil Mask
description: A circular stencil write pass controls normal/inverted scene masks and an outline pass.
controls: Space cycles normal mask, inverse mask and outline.
checks: Inside/outside pixels are compared after separate stencil write and test passes.

title: Multiple Render Targets
description: One geometry pass writes independent color, encoded normal and linear depth attachments. Each attachment is displayed.
controls: Space cycles the shared mode.
checks: Independent attachment readbacks verify a nonuniform depth buffer and distinct color/normal outputs.

title: Dynamic Cubemap
description: Six camera passes capture moving geometry in a RenderTargetCube. EnvironmentMapEffect reflects it on a sphere; six diagnostic faces appear below.
controls: Space freezes/resumes cube updates while the scene continues moving.
checks: Opposing cube faces differ and the reflected scene contains detailed output.

title: Volume Texture
description: A real Texture3D stores a generated density field. A shader shows interpolated slices or accumulates 48 samples through the volume.
controls: Space toggles slice/volume modes; Up/Down change the slice position.
checks: Changing slice depth must change output pixels.

title: Deferred Lighting
description: A geometry pass writes albedo, normals and depth. A separate fullscreen shader reconstructs world position and sums moving point lights.
controls: Space switches lighting/albedo/normals; Up/Down change light count.
checks: G-buffer attachments are checked and a different light count must change the rendered image.

title: HDR Tone Mapping
description: A HalfVector4 target preserves bright values above one. Manual and automatic exposure feed Reinhard/filmic tone mapping, with an LDR clipping reference.
controls: Space cycles manual Reinhard, filmic, LDR clipping and automatic exposure; Up/Down adjust exposure.
checks: Readback proves HDR values exceed one; changing exposure must affect the tone-mapped image.

title: Ambient Occlusion
description: Depth and normals drive a 16-sample screen-space occlusion pass followed by a depth-aware bilateral filter.
controls: Space switches composition, filtered AO and raw AO; Up/Down adjust radius.
checks: Raw AO must contain both open and occluded regions, and composition must be nonuniform.

title: Cascaded Shadow Maps
description: Three camera-depth intervals get separate directional-light depth maps. A fragment chooses its cascade and evaluates 3x3 PCF shadow comparisons.
controls: Space colors cascades; Up/Down adjust shadow bias.
checks: Each map must contain geometry; fitted light transforms must be distinct.

title: Water Rendering
description: Mirrored and regular camera passes clip geometry on opposite sides of a pool. Animated normals and Fresnel weighting combine reflection and refraction.
controls: Space toggles intermediate-target diagnostics; Up/Down adjust wave strength.
checks: Reflection and refraction readbacks must differ and contain geometry.

title: Terrain LOD
description: Convex terrain tiles choose four mesh densities by distance. Fine boundary vertices interpolate the neighboring coarse edge. Frustum culling and a wireframe view expose the result.
controls: Space toggles wireframe; Up/Down adjust camera distance.
checks: Pure tests check triangle counts and coincident seams; FNA verifies visible terrain and a reduced triangle count.

title: Video Texture
description: A real VideoPlayer decodes an original generated Theora clip. GetTexture supplies a 2D panel and a perspective 3D screen.
controls: Space pauses/resumes; L toggles looping; Up/Down adjust volume.
checks: Decoded frames must be varied, playback must advance, and pause/resume states must change.

title: Media Library Portable Portion
description: Local generated songs demonstrate MediaPlayer playback and queue control. The sample reports unavailable system MediaLibrary collections and unavailable FAudio visualization instead of inventing data.
controls: Space selects the next song; P pauses/resumes; Up/Down adjust volume.
checks: Native playback/queue state is checked. Visualization is checked only if the runtime enables the real API.

title: Gamer Profile and Friends
description: Design only: a real original-XNA Xbox Live provider must supply profile, picture and friend collections. FNA has no operational provider.
controls: No portable runtime entry is offered.
checks: Requires provider-backed sign-in, asynchronous requests, sign-out cancellation and error checks on a supported original-XNA platform.

title: Procedural Audio
description: DynamicSoundEffectInstance consumes generated mono PCM16 sine, square and sawtooth blocks. BufferNeeded maintains a bounded queue and a continuous phase.
controls: Space switches waveform; Up/Down change frequency.
checks: Waveform checks exercise phase and shape; FNA must consume and refill blocks while the voice remains playing.

title: XACT Streaming
description: AudioEngine and SoundBank play two looping cues from a real streaming WaveBank. A public cue variable drives a volume RPC, while a Music category controls the mix.
controls: Space transitions the added layer over one second; P pauses/resumes; Up/Down change category volume.
checks: Native cue state, variable roundtrip and pause/resume are checked. The bank format's streaming flag is also verified.

title: Reliable Save Game
description: A versioned JSON envelope includes payload integrity and migration. A flushed temporary file atomically replaces the primary; a valid backup recovers corruption.
controls: S saves; L loads; C corrupts the primary; F injects pre-replace failure; V writes a legacy save; Up/Down change coins.
checks: Roundtrip, interruption preservation, checksum validation, migration and backup recovery are tested in isolated temporary storage.

title: Content Streaming
description: Background tasks prepare room pixels. Main-thread uploads are bounded to one per update. Canceled generations are discarded and residency keeps only the current room and neighbors.
controls: Space moves forward; Up moves backward.
checks: Defined checks wait for CPU tasks, count GPU uploads/disposals and prove bounded residency after room changes.

title: Input Rebinding
description: An action map captures keyboard/gamepad bindings, rejects conflicts, resets defaults and atomically persists JSON.
controls: Up/Down select an action; Enter starts capture; Esc cancels capture; S/L save/load; Space restores defaults.
checks: Conflict rejection preserves the old binding, reserved exit keys are protected and malformed persisted maps are rejected.

title: Game Loop Timing
description: Three lanes compare variable integration, fixed updates and interpolation. A simulated render rate and injected stalls expose catch-up limits and dropped time.
controls: Space injects a stall; Up/Down adjust simulated frame rate.
checks: Ten-second simulations at five render rates preserve distance; interpolation stays bounded and catch-up cannot spiral.

title: Rigid Body Physics
description: Oriented rectangle SAT and convex clipping build two-point manifolds. Iterative accumulated impulses resolve rotation, restitution and Coulomb friction. A pin joint constrains a pendulum.
controls: Space spawns a box; Up/Down adjust friction; C toggles contact markers.
checks: Tests cover separated/contacting boxes, torque, settling, friction and joint stability; FNA checks finite motion and active contacts.

title: Navigation and Behavior
description: Vertical decomposition makes convex free-space polygons around inflated obstacles. Portal adjacency supports A*, then exact segment tests prune corners. A reactive behavior tree chooses chase, remembered search or patrol.
controls: Space hides/shows the target; clicking free space moves the target.
checks: Routes must preserve obstacle clearance; disconnected regions reject paths; behavior transitions and memory expiry are tested.
